note: Narration for Reverence. One calm, warm, unhurried voice — a storyteller at the edge of a campfire the size of the universe. Leave air around every sentence.

lines.text: Before the first light, there was a silence so complete that nothing had ever broken it.
Then — everything. Every sun, every sea, every atom of you, flung outward in a single breath.
Gravity gathered the dark into rivers. And the rivers caught fire.
A hundred billion suns began to turn together, slow as a thought.
Around them, small worlds waited to see what they would become.
Some of them woke. They raised cities. They made music. They looked up.
All of it is made of the same first light. So are you.
This is everything there is. Every thread of light is a hundred thousand galaxies.
Canticle. Four hundred billion suns, and one of them is yours.
Another island of suns. No one has named these stars yet.
The Source. Here, even light kneels.
Go on. The sky was never a ceiling.
From up here, every border is invisible.
Look up. That river of light is home, seen from the inside.
There it is. That feeling. Stay in it.
Someone stood here once, and wondered the same things you do.
A new world. Walk softly. It has never met you before.
Take your time. The universe is in no hurry.
